shown.summary: Every marketing page said the good independent teaching in that field happens in newsletters rather than video. We had searched one corner of marketing. When we searched the rest we found several people teaching at length on video, and took the note down.

The badges on each creator were described as reflecting our own admission rules — that we do not list someone explaining a skill they have never practised. Measured, 29 of 196 creators carried no practitioner badge, so it was not a rule at all. The badges describe the subject, not our standards.
This page said a creator typically appears under two to four skills. The real median was one, and had been for weeks. The number came from a planning document and was never checked against the list.
The footer said we keep two things in your browser. The code kept five. Nothing sensitive, and nothing left your device, but the count was wrong and stayed wrong until it was measured.
